title: Concierge Care Partners with The Sheridan to expand Senior Home Care Services in Western Suburbs | User | mammothtimes.com
text:
Concierge Care, a senior home care company based in Chicago, has partnered with The Sheridan at Oak Brook—Senior Lifestyle to support its effort to expand into the Western suburbs.
CHICAGO, Illinois - April 16, 2025 - Concierge Care , a senior home care company based in Chicago, has partnered with The Sheridan at Oak Brook—Senior Lifestyle, in a move that will support its effort to expand into the Western suburbs.
Concierge Care Partner, Jim Wong, explains, “We want to provide our world-class home care to seniors in Greater Chicago, and partnering with The Sheridan—Senior Lifestyle is the perfect way to expand our services within our target market.” He continues, “Our caregivers will provide care to the residents within The Sheridan, and we are excited about this opportunity.”
Partnering with The Sheridan allows Concierge Care to serve families across several Western suburbs including Oak Brook, Elmhurst, Hinsdale, Clarendon Hills, Western Springs, LaGrange, Downers Grove, Naperville and more.
In April 2024, Founder Dr. Ken Breger partnered with Jim Wong and Mike Robinson of WWR Home Care to rebrand the originally named Concierge Home Integrative Care to Concierge Care.
Built on the foundational pillars of trust, service, and compassion, and backed by physician-led medical expertise, Concierge Care is dedicated to growing its service offerings and client-reach both organically and with future acquisitions.
Robinson says, “The opportunity to serve new client families in the Western Suburbs is exciting for our team. This partnership is another step in taking Concierge Care into its next chapter. I look forward to making additional investments, which will lead to further growth and success for the organization.” He adds, “Above anything, our mission is to make people’s lives better, especially our clients, families, and caregivers, so for me, that is most important.”
Concierge Care provides home care services for seniors, including personal care, 24/7 care, wellness visits, medication management, coordination of care with other health professionals, and bathing, dressing, escorting, housekeeping, laundry, and fitness assistance. The caregivers can provide care in a senior’s home or in age-in-place communities such as independent/assisted/memory.
To learn more about Concierge Care, visit senior-homecare.com
About Concierge
Founded by physician Dr. Ken Breger, Concierge Care is a home-care company built upon the three pillars of trust, service, and compassion. Concierge Care assists seniors in need of home care. In April 2024, Dr. Breger partnered with Mike Robinson and Jim Wong to collaborate towards fulfilling his dual vision of being the most trusted home care company for clients and their families and being the employer of choice for all caregivers in the industry.
